_metadata.description: Auto-recovery engine (live): restart cloudflared / re-push config with exponential backoff + circuit breaker as the single authoritative restart owner, with a persisted recovery event log.

requirements.title: Restart cloudflared / re-push config on /ready failure or HA=0
requirements.description: On a /ready failure or HA-connections=0 the engine takes a recovery action (restart cloudflared or re-push config) live, driven by the failure classification.

requirements.title: Apply exponential backoff and a circuit breaker to recovery attempts
requirements.description: Successive recovery attempts back off exponentially, and a circuit breaker stops further automatic restarts after a threshold of consecutive failures, surfacing an alert instead.

requirements.title: Act as the single authoritative owner of cloudflared restart
requirements.description: Cloudflared restart is mutually exclusive to the recovery engine so concurrent or external restarts (e.g. vrooli-autoheal, now alert-only) cannot race the engine.

requirements.title: Persist a recovery event log of attempts, actions, and outcomes
requirements.description: Each recovery attempt records trigger, action, outcome, and timestamps in the recovery_events table for post-incident review.
